description: Fetch the full normalized spec record for one Amazon ASIN (or amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> URL) from any of the 47 categories, including which category it belongs to and its `amazon_affiliate_url`.

asin.description: 10-character Amazon ASIN (e.g. "B0CFZPSPBY") or full amazon.com/dp/... URL.

category.description: Optional hint; the ASIN is still looked up across every category if it is not there.

name: get_product_by_asin
